description: This file defines hooks for the Drupal toolbar module, including functions to add and alter toolbar items such as search, home link, shopping cart tray, and user messages.

methods.name: hook_toolbar
methods.description: Defines toolbar items such as search, home link, shopping cart, and messages for the Drupal toolbar.

methods.name: hook_toolbar_alter
methods.description: Modifies the toolbar items after their initial definition, e.g., reordering the 'commerce' tab.
